title: Edgar Mitchell said no astronaut ever saw a UFO in space

tellings.quote: Yeah, the thing he was very adamant

plain: The Apollo astronaut Edgar Mitchell is said to have insisted that no astronaut ever saw a UFO in space. The UFO researcher Clas Svahn, who spoke with Mitchell, tells Michels this was something Mitchell "was very adamant" about. It matters because it cuts against the many stories of astronauts spotting strange craft while in orbit.
